text: At its meeting on January 22, 2020, the Toronto Police Services Board was in receipt of a report from, Ryan Teschner, Executive Director, with regard to City of Toronto Council Decision – Request to Establish a Community Police Office at 200 Poplar Road. The Board approved Mr. Teschner’s report and agreed that a copy be forwarded to the City of Toronto Executive Committee. A copy of the Board minute P10/2020 regarding this matter is attached.
The Executive Committee received the letter (July 3, 2020) from the Toronto Police Services Board for information.
